dashboard.label: Ingest Path Lab
dashboard.description: Temporary lab to compare ingest-path visualisation designs before promoting a winner to Delivery IN.

search.query: $base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | stats count by group_value | sort group_value

$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | eval selected_group=if(len("$selected_group$")=0,"*","$selected_group$") | eval selected_group_wrapped="|" . selected_group . "|" | where selected_group="*" OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|" . group_value . "|%") | eval source_s=coalesce(source,"") | eval sourcetype_s=coalesce(sourcetype,"") | eval ingress_channel=case( match(source_s,"^http:"), "HEC", match(source_s,"^udp:"), "UDP", match(source_s,"^tcp:"), "TCP", match(source_s,"(?i)^WinEventLog"), "WinEventLog", match(source_s,"^stream:"), "Splunk Stream", match(source_s,"(?i)^lambda:"), "Cloud ingest", match(source_s,"(?i)firehose"), "Cloud ingest", match(source_s,"^s3://"), "Cloud ingest", match(sourcetype_s,"^aws:"), "Cloud ingest", match(source_s,"(?i)UniversalForwarder|SplunkUniversalForwarder"), "UF path/script", match(source_s,"(?i)^Perfmon") OR match(sourcetype_s,"(?i)^Perfmon"), "Modular input", match(source_s,"^[/\\\\]") OR match(source_s,"^[A-Za-z]:[\\\\/]"), "File monitor", true(), "Unclassified" ) | eval receiver=coalesce(splunk_server,"unknown") | fields group_value host source sourcetype receiver ingress_channel

| stats count as events dc(group_value) as sources dc(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(receiver) as receivers by ingress_channel | eventstats sum(events) as total_events | eval pct=round(100*events/total_events,1) | sort - events ingress_channel | fields ingress_channel events sources sourcetypes receivers pct total_events
| stats count as events by group_value ingress_channel receiver | sort - events | head 200

div.div: Temporary prototypes for inferred ingress / last-hop evidence. Not a certified topology map. Compare designs, then we promote a winner to Delivery IN.

div.p: What this shows: Receivers in the centre, ingress channels in orbit sized by event volume.
Read it as: Inferred from source patterns in the sample (HEC, UDP, File monitor, Stream, Cloud, etc.). Unclassified means no strong heuristic matched.
What this shows: Data Source → Ingress channel → Receiver, with band thickness for event count.
Read it as: Best when the scope spans many sources and you want path diversity, not just channel mix.
What this shows: DIG-style share tiles per ingress channel.
Read it as: Pragmatic baseline for quick comparison and classifier sanity checks.
What this shows: Source examples mapped to ingress_channel so you can tune heuristics against real data.
Read it as: Debugging surface for the lab classifier. Promote lookup overrides later if UF/HF/Edge need explicit mapping.

search.query: | stats count as events values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(receiver) as receivers dc(group_value) as group_values by ingress_channel source | eval pct_note="share within channel rows below" | eventstats sum(events) as channel_events by ingress_channel | eval channel_pct=round(100*events/channel_events,1) | rename ingress_channel as Channel source as Source events as Events channel_pct as "Channel %" sourcetypes as Sourcetypes receivers as Receivers group_values as "Group values" | table Channel Source Events "Channel %" Sourcetypes Receivers "Group values" | sort Channel - Events

| rename ingress_channel as Channel events as Events pct as "Share %" sources as Sources sourcetypes as Sourcetypes receivers as Receivers | table Channel Events "Share %" Sources Sourcetypes Receivers | sort - Events
